sammy subs.description: Sammy's movie-clip subtitles: bold yellow-orange (#FFE54C), thick black outline, lowercase, bottom centre (size 64 at 1080p). The default for finished films.

meme.description: Meme Stack: 9:16, punchy hook (line1 white, line2 gold), credit, big white captions under the video.

drama.description: Drama Stack: 9:16, line1 = title, line2 = 'Part N' (set "part"). No jokes, no emojis.

wide stack.description: Stack with a wider crop, for characters near the frame edges (like the Usual Suspects clip).

boxed subs.description: White subtitles on a black box (busy backgrounds).

quiet music.description: Music ducked under dialogue at the auto level (about 12.5 LU below the dialogue).
